title: Helping Hands A-Z
hook: A job is more than its easiest gesture.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D community-helper storybook, respectful everyday service scenes, clear foregrounds; visual identity: Helping Hands A-Z

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing visible work and invisible expertise
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Helping Hands A-Z about visible hands versus invisible expertise: many jobs use hands, but judgment, communication, training, planning, observation, and teamwork matter more than hand motions.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child notices why miming a job can be misleading, especially medical, electrical, rescue, welding, and legal work.
